explanation: The statement says: take an ideal J of C, an element t ∈ J, and a set T of elements x of K with x·t in the image of J. Then every element b of `Algebra.adjoin C T` satisfies b·t^N = c for some N and some c ∈ J^N. This is the description of the affine blowup algebra C[J/t]. The proof is a direct induction on `Algebra.adjoin` and uses only basic ideal lemmas (`Ideal.mul_mem_mul`, `Ideal.pow_mem_pow`); it does not apply any single Mathlib result. I looked for a Mathlib counterpart in four ways: (1) a regex for conclusions of the form `∃ N : ℕ, ∃ c ∈ J ^ N, …`; (2) adjoin/pow/algebraMap patterns; (3) lemma names like `exists_pow_mul` and `mul_pow_mem` in RingTheory; (4) files on blowups, dilatations and Rees algebras. `Mathlib/RingTheory/ReesAlgebra.lean` exists, but it is about the polynomial-subalgebra Rees algebra and has no such statement. I found no affine blowup or dilatation development in Mathlib.
